description: This class includes the wholesale and retail sale of new and used vehicles: passenger motor vehicles, including specialized passenger motor vehicles such as ambulances and minibuses.
includes: wholesale and retail sale of new and used passenger motor vehicles
wholesale and retail sale of off-road motor vehicles: jeeps, four-wheel drive vehicles
wholesale and retail sale of vans and trucks
wholesale and retail sale of buses and coaches
wholesale and retail sale of specialized motor vehicles: ambulances, hearses
wholesale and retail sale of camping vehicles: motor homes
sale of motor vehicles on behalf of third parties (agents)
excludes: wholesale and retail sale of parts and accessories for motor vehicles, see 4530
rental and leasing of motor vehicles, see 7710
